## GuardianSignals #1

Inverts the new-flagger guard, so a quorum-crossing flag returns early.

- **Mutant:** [`1.sol`](1.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`rcGsFlagLatchesBanAtQuorumIsReachable`](../../specs/GuardianSignals/GuardianSignals_reachability.spec#L125)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh GuardianSignals 1`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/GuardianSignals/reachability.conf --rule rcGsFlagLatchesBanAtQuorumIsReachable`

```diff
--- a/src/GuardianSignals.sol
+++ b/src/GuardianSignals.sol
@@ -439,7 +439,7 @@
         if (account == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();

         GuardiansSignal storage signal = _signals[marketId][account];
-        if (!signal.flaggedBy.add(guardian)) return;
+        if (signal.flaggedBy.add(guardian)) return;

         uint256 strikes = signal.flaggedBy.length();
         if (strikes >= _quorum && !signal.banned) {
```

## GuardianSignals #6
